newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks dip on caution ahead of election.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks dip on caution ahead of election.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks closed down on Monday due to profit-taking and caution ahead of Friday's local government poll, brokers said.
The all share index closed 3.34 points down at 633.45. Ceylon Tobacco fell 50 cents to 35.50 rupees, Development Finance seven to 255, Hayleys three to 200, John Keells Holdings 1.50 rupees to 200.

"The index fell on profit-taking by small investors among blue chips," said Gordon Nadesan, a trader at brokerage CT Smith. Small investors who are the most affected by volatility, also moved to the sidelines ahead of the elections, he said.
Brokers, however, said institutional buyers were still prepared to pay a premium for parcels of growth stocks.
"You cannot find substantial quantities of the types of stocks institutional buyers are interested in," said Alistair Corera, a trader at brokerage Forbes & Walker.
Turnover was 23.89 million rupees on 1.9 million shares led by 70,000 CTC Eagle Insurance, 1.5 million Distilleries Co.
A parcel of 2.3 million shares of Kotagala Plantations Ltd which has been on bid on an all-or-none basis at 23 rupees each since Friday, will be concluded on Tuesday.
